fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-03-21 states that the brother of the complainant, Rajeshwari Rani, aged 18, left for work and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Nila Nagar Bus Stand Area, on 2025-03-18 at approximately 16:00. The complaint was lodged by Dinesh Nathan (9000000420), a family member of Rajeshwari Rani, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000291. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, photograph, afternoon, bus stand
